name: tripartite motif containing 37
pathways: negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II

function.text: TRIM37 encodes E3 ubiquitin-protein ligase TRIM37. Annotated molecular activities include transcription coactivator activity and protein homodimerization activity. It participates in negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II and aggresome assembly.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to mulibrey nanism (autosomal recessive).

somatic.text: This gene is included in cancer-panel definitions, but a disease-specific somatic association has not been assigned from the alteration-context sources reviewed for this draft.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal recessive; definitive GenCC assertion from ClinGen. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.
